entries.zh: 继续；绵延不断（绵续），西语有划改痕迹，释义取存续义
entries.en: to continue, to carry on; to be prolonged
entries.notes: 词头含删除线 casar，四栏仍互证绵续＝继续义，故 medium。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕仅西语缩写 Contra.（相反、对抗），汉闽官三栏皆空
entries.en: against; contrary (abbreviation only; Chinese/Hokkien/Mandarin columns empty)
entries.notes: [空] 栏且缩写 p̃ 存疑（p̃/q），无四栏互证。

entries.zh: 非理；违背道理、不合情理
entries.en: unreasonable, against reason; wrong

entries.zh: 忤；抵触、顶撞（忤逆之义的单字）
entries.en: to oppose, to go against; to contradict

entries.zh: 纵；依己意任意违逆、放恣而行（闽栏残缺）
entries.en: willfully; to act contrary at one's own pleasure
entries.notes: source_M 标 [残]，展开依赖汉字与官话对音推断。

entries.zh: 逆；违逆、忤逆
entries.en: to go against; disobedient, rebellious

entries.zh: 横；蛮横强逆、横行不驯（横蛮逆）
entries.en: perverse, unruly; to act contrary by force

entries.zh: 徇；违逆、拂逆尊长之意（ael superior＝对上违逆）
entries.en: to disobey one's superior; to cross the will of elders

entries.zh: 忤逆；忤逆父母尊长、不孝
entries.en: disobedient and rebellious (esp. toward parents); unfilial

entries.zh: 悖逆；叛逆、乖悖不驯
entries.en: perverse and rebellious; to act contrary and unruly

entries.zh: 悖谬；荒悖错谬、言行乖谬
entries.en: absurd, perverse and erroneous
entries.notes: R 栏照抄上一条 ngūe 与汉字謬的音不合，西语词头亦有划改，依汉字与 M 栏定释义。

entries.zh: 相反；与劝诫相违、彼此相对立
entries.en: contrary, opposed; to contradict an admonition

entries.zh: 相背；互相违背、彼此相左
entries.en: to contradict one another; mutually opposed

entries.zh: 抵撞；顶嘴争辩、与人顶撞（对说话者相抵）
entries.en: to bump against in speech; to talk back, to contradict someone
entries.notes: M 栏后半 L quy quy 转写不明，依汉字抵撞与官话定释义。

entries.zh: 违禁；违犯禁令（违规）
entries.en: to violate a prohibition; to break the law

entries.zh: 违逆；违背抗逆
entries.en: to disobey and oppose; disobedience

entries.zh: 抵口；口头上顶撞、言语相抗
entries.en: to contradict in words; verbal opposition, to talk back

entries.zh: 忤鬼；顶撞鬼神、冒犯邪鬼（begay＝闽南 bê-guî 邪鬼）
entries.en: to offend or defy ghosts/spirits (begay, the Hokkien evil spirit)
entries.notes: 词头含闽南语借词 begay，展开依赖 17c 传教语境推断。

entries.zh: 横逆；蛮横无理的侵凌（亦谓横加违逆，与德行相悖）
entries.en: violence and insolence; wrongful oppression (to contradict virtue)

entries.zh: 争讼刁难；与人争辩诉讼、口角刁蹬（汉栏残缺）
entries.en: to wrangle, to dispute litigiously; to pick a quarrel
entries.notes: [残] 汉栏首字缺损，仅刁字与 tiáu 音可据，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 抵撞；顶撞说话之人、出言相抗
entries.en: to contradict the speaker; to talk back

entries.zh: 激；性情偏激、天生与人相忤
entries.en: naturally contrary; of a passionate, contrary disposition
